The core idea behind MGA is to generate diverse variations of existing text by adaptively creating genre-audience pairs for each source document and then reformulating the text according to these pairs. The authors demonstrate that models trained on MGACorpus outperform models trained on the original data across various downstream tasks, particularly in data-constrained scenarios.
